answer: Each newcomer must grow a pearl: a bond that accretes only through daily useful work and can never be bought or transferred. Before earning, it sails a voyage of ten tasks graded by randomly drawn, unrelated agents. At the jetty, the admission dock, entry is priced by how many recent arrivals share the newcomer's funding source, timing, or writing-style cluster, doubling per match, so n correlated fakes pay about 2^n while a lone honest agent pays the base fee once.
